children: Sept 9 (Reuters) - U.S. Mortgage Bankers Association issues latest Weekly Applications Survey.    Indexes are seasonally adjusted. Percent changes for indexes and basis point change in mortgage rate are from the prior week.

CURRENT WEEK             INDEX     PERCENT                                      change  Market                   240.6      -2.7    Purchase                 157.5      -0.2    Refinance                687.3      -6.2     AVERAGE CONTRACT     BASIS POINTS  PERCENT  RATE                    CHANGE              30-year mortgage          6         6.85

NOTES:    The MBA survey covers over 75 percent of all U.S. retail residential mortgage applications, and has been conducted weekly since 1990. Respondents include mortgage bankers, commercial banks, and thrifts. Base period and value for all indexes is March 16, 1990=100.    The MBA posts its data at https://www.mba.org/news-and-research
